note: Set B binds values to the correct components and keeps detail conditions (threaded rod 3/4" in A6, plywood deck and reclaimed wood surface 5 1/2" widths, bolt length 4", grade level 0", footing 3 1/2" and 1'-0" in C1), with only vague/invented attributes on the 1 1/2" and 3 3/4" items. Set A invents or misbinds several claims: decking thickness 1 1/2" (decking is 3/4" x 5 1/2"), 'deck module section height 1 1/4"', 'component 1 width 1'-0"', and an invented 'offset from edge to post 2' attribute, plus a vague 'decking support height 7 1/2"'. A does capture useful facts B omits (1" nut, 2" x 8" frame, drawing scales), but its errors are more numerous and more serious.
